title: NBD: Handshake negotiation and STARTTLS
description:
Add support for "newstyle" handshakes and option negotiation.
Add request and response tracking for options.

The handshake is annoying because unlike the transmission mode,
not all messages have magic bytes; certain responses are bare
bytes given in response to a message from the other direction
(which did have magic bytes.)

Support STARTTLS mode.

Register the IANA assigned port number.
Also register the IANA assigned port number to TLS for cases where
the capture starts after STARTTLS.

Still to do: more detailed dissection of the option types, possibly
"old style" handshakes.

Ping #13034
